name: Hotel, guesthouse or holiday rental
description: A hotel, guesthouse, holiday flat or cottage: a page for each room, extra services such as breakfast, wellness or transfers, events and guests' questions, with facts about check-in and check-out, booking, pets, parking, breakfast, the city tax and cancellation.

questions.question: Where do guests book – what is the address of your booking engine or booking page?
questions.help: Every Book button on the site leads here; Kaleta shows the rooms but has no availability calendar or payments. Leave it empty if guests book by e-mail or phone – the buttons then lead to the contact page.

questions.question: From what time can guests check in, and how does a late arrival work?
questions.help: For example "15:00–20:00, later arrivals with a key box – call ahead".

questions.question: By what time do guests check out?
questions.help: For example "by 10:00, late check-out on request".

questions.question: Do you accept pets? On what conditions?
questions.help: For example "dogs welcome, 10 EUR per night, not in the breakfast room" or "no pets".

questions.question: Where can guests park, and does it cost anything?
questions.help: For example "free private car park, charging point for electric cars".

questions.question: Do you serve breakfast? Is it included in the price?
questions.help: For example "buffet 7:30–10:00, included" or "on request for 12 EUR per person".

questions.question: Do guests pay a local or tourist tax on top of the price? How do you state it?
questions.help: As you state it to guests, e.g. "2 EUR per adult per night, paid on arrival". The municipality sets the amount and the exemptions – check the current rules there.

questions.question: What is your cancellation policy for direct bookings?
questions.help: In your own words, the same as in your booking terms, e.g. "free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival, then 50 %". Booking platforms may apply their own terms.

audit.message: Add your rooms or apartments with real photos, how many guests they take and a price from – guests book by them.
The rooms have not changed for a year – check the prices from, the price notes and the amenities.
State your check-in times – guests plan their journey by them.
State your cancellation policy – guests look for it before they book directly.
Add the address in Business details – guests navigate by it and search engines show it on the map.

claude: Guests come for the rooms, the price from, what is included and how to book – each room type is one item of the rooms collection with real photos, and every Book button leads to {{fact.booking_url}}, or to the contact page when it is empty. Kaleta has no availability, prices per date or payments, so never promise free rooms, instant confirmation or a best-price guarantee. Check-in, check-out, pets, parking, breakfast, the city tax and cancellation are facts – write {{fact.…}} instead of repeating them, so every page says the same. Never invent prices, star ratings or classifications, reviews, awards, distances or amenities – ask the owner. State the cancellation policy and the city tax only as the owner gives them, and say that tax and guest registration rules should be checked with the municipality rather than stating them as law. Describe the place and its surroundings warmly but concretely.
